title: Museum
subtitle: 「博物館／美術館／展覽中心／文化機構／展覽空間」，究竟是哪一種 museum？
description: 「博物館／美術館／展覽中心／文化機構／展覽空間」，究竟是哪一種 museum？

words.note: 使用者提供的核心近義詞。當 museum 主要展示藝術作品時，gallery 很自然；但 gallery 也可指商業畫廊，所以不是所有 museum 都能替換。
words.example: The gallery is displaying modern sculpture this month.

exercises.original: The museum specialises in paintings and sculpture from the twentieth century.

falseSynonyms.zh: gallery 通常更專注藝術作品；museum 可以涵蓋歷史、科學、自然、科技等更多類型。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The gallery exhibits contemporary painting. The museum explains the history of aviation.

falseSynonyms.zh: exhibition centre 以舉辦臨時展覽、展銷或活動為主，未必有永久收藏。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The exhibition centre hosts trade fairs. The museum preserves a permanent collection.

falseSynonyms.zh: cultural institution 比 museum 更廣，可包括 libraries、archives、theatres、galleries 等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The museum is a cultural institution. Not every cultural institution is a museum.

falseSynonyms.zh: exhibition space 是展示用的物理空間，可以只是 museum 裡的一個房間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The museum opened a new exhibition space. The museum employs curators and conservators.

falseSynonyms.zh: heritage centre 通常較地方化、主題化，聚焦某地歷史與傳統，不一定具備 museum 的收藏研究功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The heritage centre tells the town's industrial story. The national museum holds millions of objects.

falseSynonyms.zh: interpretive centre 重點是解釋某個自然／歷史 site；museum 不必依附某一地點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The interpretive centre explains the battlefield. The museum contains collections from many regions.

falseSynonyms.zh: cultural centre 通常是多用途場所，可有演出、課程、工作坊和展覽。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cultural centre hosts concerts and classes. The museum preserves and displays artefacts.

falseSynonyms.zh: archive 主要保存文件、記錄和原始資料；museum 通常保存並展示物件或標本。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The archive preserves government records. The museum displays archaeological objects.
